messages:
Lina Gomez: Hi team, first day and I can't access the internal docs at https://docs.internal.redwood while on VPN. Browser hangs. VPN status: Connected (split-tunnel). Anyone have a quick checklist?
Ethan (IT): Welcome Lina! :wave: Quick checks: which OS and which VPN client? Can you paste `ip route` or `route print`? Also try `dig docs.internal.redwood` to see DNS.
Lina Gomez: macOS 14.1, using the Redwood mac client from the quickstart. `ip route` shows only `10.9.0.0/24 via 10.9.0.1 dev utun0` nothing for 10.0/8. `dig` resolves docs.internal.redwood -> 10.0.8.22.
Ravi (Infra): Looks like the corporate route wasn't pushed. We recently rotated the per-user route policy. Ethan can push the 10.0.0.0/8 route for your account. Meanwhile you can reach the docs via the bastion web-proxy at https://bastion-proxy.redwood.internal/docs (requires SSO).
it-bot: Created IT ticket IT-4999 for Lina Gomez (automated).
Ethan (IT): Pushed route and added your client ID to the allowlist. Please disconnect and reconnect the VPN and then test 
``
ping 10.0.8.22
curl -I https://docs.internal.redwood/health
```
Lina Gomez: Reconnected and ping replies good (ttl=64). curl -I returns HTTP/200. :tada: Thanks!
Ethan (IT): Great. I'll update the onboarding doc to note the policy prompt that some users miss (accepting it triggers route push). Closing IT-4999; reopen if flakey.
Ravi (Infra): If you want persistent bastion SSH/web access for local testing, DM me your public key and I'll add temporary access.
Lina Gomez: Will DM the key, thanks everyone!
